preconditions.description: n and k are integers where n is between 1 and 300,000 (inclusive) and k is between 0 and 1,000,000,000,000,000,000 (inclusive).
Input consists of exactly two integers n and k separated by whitespace.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Impossible' or (len(stdout) == 2 * int(n) and all(c in '()' for c in stdout) and is_regular_bracket_sequence(stdout) and total_nesting_sum(stdout) == int(k))
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, stdout is a regular bracket sequence of length 2n with total nesting sum exactly k; otherwise, stdout is 'Impossible'.
